title: Width bound for seed formula clauses
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive verifier with Boolean input alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $p$, and $r$ query positions, where $0<r<3$, and let $s$ be one of its seeds. Every clause occurring in the associated padded seed CNF on $r+r2^r$ coordinates has width at most $3$.
